SHARED-F-2-S75.title: Consent API Endpoints and Contract Exposure
SHARED-F-2-S75.description: Expose consent framework via FastAPI endpoints for capturing consent decisions, querying current consent tier, and updating consent state. Ensure strict Pydantic validation and alignment with tool_router usage patterns.

SHARED-F-2-S76.title: Integration with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Services
SHARED-F-2-S76.description: Integrate consent enforcement into lead capture and unknown question flows, ensuring Tier 2 consent is required before identifiable data storage and that de-identification is applied otherwise.
